selected_modules.title: Default account review
selected_modules.rationale: Defaults and shared credentials are high-risk in PLC environments.

selected_modules.title: Password policy strength
selected_modules.rationale: Classroom systems should still demonstrate strong password policy configuration.

selected_modules.title: Segmentation and management subnet restrictions
selected_modules.rationale: OT access should be narrowed to approved management paths.

selected_modules.title: Industrial protocol exposure review
selected_modules.rationale: Protocol availability should be documented and protected, especially Modbus-related paths.

selected_modules.title: Firmware and diagnostic evidence capture
selected_modules.rationale: Version and diagnostic state should be captured in exported evidence for review.
